all_jobs.description: Owns AI, agents and data intelligence across the company: one trusted view of the business, an agent anyone can ask, and agents running repeatable work. Owns custom LLM agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, MCP), finance agents (NetSuite, Shopify, Amazon reconciliations), ops agents, daily sweep, human-approval rules, access controls, audit trail, cost/accuracy reports, single view across sales channels (CAC, LTV, ROAS, margin), context layer across Slack/Notion/Docs, customer 360, team guidance, keep/replace/build tool recommendations. Requires: shipped AI agents/data products used company-wide; led people/programs; strong SQL and Python; LLMs, agents, MCP, retrieval, evaluation; cloud warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake; APIs, pipelines, Shopify/NetSuite/Amazon data; A/B testing; advanced English.
